notes:
Account background:
- Mid-market customer-engagement SaaS; product: conversational assistant embedded in client dashboards (agent handoff + tool calls).
- Current stack: microservices on AWS (us-east-1, eu-west-1), Node.js backend, PostgreSQL.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-02-18: Intro call (Ava) — customer goals: consistent p95 < 350ms for short-turn responses, streaming for long responses, tool-calling for account lookups.
- 2026-02-24: Demo of Redwood hosted API (Ravi) — showed streaming + function calls; customer liked streaming but cautious on regional jitter.
- 2026-03-03: Security sync (Lena) — requested SOC2 + KMS integration details; legal asked about EU residency.
- 2026-03-08: Pricing discussion — asked for Hosted vs Dedicated TCO for 1M monthly tokens and 10M monthly tokens.
- 2026-03-11: Design call — discussed smart routing: prefer NA primary, failover to EU replica only for non-PII; asked about automatic fallback to smaller model for burst protection.

Customer quotes / highlights:
- "Latency is the product — if we miss p95, retention drops." — VP Product
- Prioritized: streaming responsiveness, reliable tool-calling for live account lookups, predictable cost curve.

Technical requirements / acceptance criteria:
- POC must demonstrate NA (us-east-1) p95 < 350ms for 8k token context conversational baseline.
- Streaming must start sending tokens within 150ms of response start in 90% of requests.
- Tool calls (function-calling) must round-trip within 200-300ms typical (including model call + backend lookup).
- Fallback policy: automatic model-variant fallback with no more than 500ms added latency; graceful degradation of quality acceptable.
- Data residency: EU tenant data must stay in eu-west-1 for EU customer accounts.

Operational notes / POC plan:
- Proposed POC: 2-week hosted API trial using us-east-1 and eu-west-1 endpoints; synthetic traffic plus 3 customer flows.
- Logging: request/response traces to be shared with HarborByte team (anonymized) for latency breakdowns.
- Success metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency by region, streaming time-to-first-token, tool-call RT, cost per 1k tokens.

Open questions for engineering & pricing:
- Can Redwood surface a per-route streaming SLA for hosted customers?
- Need example routing policy that pins EU users to eu-west unless capacity constraints — how is fallback surfaced to the app?
- Dedicated delta: what fixed monthly commit yields 30% cost saving vs hosted at projected volume?

Next proposed steps (short):
- 2026-03-14: Kickoff POC (Ava/Ravi) — supply sample traffic + test harness.
- 2026-03-18: Provide Hosted API demo config + routing policy template.
- 2026-03-25: Mid-POC check-in to validate metrics and iterate.

Focus: strict latency SLOs (p95 <350ms), streaming responsiveness, function-calling RTs, and region-aware routing (NA/EU) with graceful fallback. pain_points: current provider has regional jitter and opaque cost; tool-calling round trips inconsistent; retention impacted by slow agent responses
